text:
Which statement about photosynthesis is correct?
A
It decreases the amount of oxygen in the atmosphere.
B
It is a reaction between carbon dioxide and water.
C
It produces a gas that contributes to increased global warming.
D
It requires a temperature greater than 50°C.

options.label: A
options.text: It decreases the amount of oxygen in the atmosphere.

options.label: B
options.text: It is a reaction between carbon dioxide and water.

options.label: C
options.text: It produces a gas that contributes to increased global warming.

options.label: D
options.text: It requires a temperature greater than 50°C.
